title: Your Microwave Clock Drifts. Your Phone Never Does
topic: Many appliance clocks count the mains power wiggle (50 or 60 times a second); in 2018 a grid dispute in Europe slowed it and clocks lost 6 minutes. Phones get time from the network.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: Everyone has two clocks that disagree; no explainer Short.
